title: First-run dashboard: progressive empty states, contextual guides, and template discoverability
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Goal: Improve first-time user activation and discoverability in Redwood Console by rethinking empty dashboard states, adding progressive disclosure patterns, and shipping a lightweight in-product education layer (tooltips, short guides, and ready-made templates).

Scope: design and prototype UI for: 1) Landing dashboard empty state when no routes/models are configured; 2) Per-feature contextual empty states (rollouts, cost views, logs); 3) A short onboarding coachmark flow that can be skipped or replayed; 4) Template gallery (prompts + route templates) surfaced in empty states and the ‘Create’ flow; 5) Lightweight in-console microcopy and tooltip guidance for pricing/cost controls.

Why: New engineering/product teams onboard quickly but frequently abandon after encountering blank dashboards with no next action. This work aims to reduce time-to-first-success (create a route or run a test inference) by providing clear first steps, templates, and just-in-time education.

Success metrics: increase in first-week route creation rate by +18%, reduce support tickets labeled "confusing console" by 30%, and increase template usage from new accounts to >=25% of first actions.

Links: Figma prototype (see attachments), research notes from onboarding interviews in Drive, initial copy doc in Confluence.
acceptance_criteria: Empty dashboard shows clear primary action CTA and at least two contextual templates
Coachmark tour triggers for new orgs and is skippable; replayable from Help menu
Tooltips available on cost controls and rollout toggles with concise examples
Figma prototype linked and user-tested with 6 participants (3 engineers, 3 PMs)
A11y: all coachmarks and tooltips are keyboard-navigable and screen-reader announced
decisions: Use progressive disclosure: prioritize single-step CTAs over multi-step wizards to minimize cognitive load
Templates are opinionated but editable: seed with common tasks (quick API route, batch embedding, infer with cache) rather than full production configs
Keep template creation in-console lightweight: 'Use template' opens config modal with recommended defaults
Do not block telemetry opt-in behind tour; telemetry opt-in handled separately via account settings
Defer full multi-lingual copy and internationalization until acceptance testing; placeholders added for translatable strings
tasks: Finalize three template designs and their example payloads (deadline 2025-02-18)
Deliver high-fidelity Figma screens for dashboard, rollouts, and cost empty states (Sofia)
Coordinate 6 usability sessions with Growth Research and schedule follow-ups
Write microcopy for tooltips and coachmarks and run a readability pass
Prepare dev-ready spec with component variants and accessibility notes
